[[File:The Red Grail.png|right|200px|thumb|The Red Grail]]
{{Quote|'Seek the Cup in the birthing-bed', the Pine-Knight is told. The Midwife at the birthing-bed, to his amazement, is the Mountain-Mother. In a fit of awe, he both gelds and flays himself. The Vigilant Storm burst joyfully from the remains.|"Robert Fludd", ''The Orchid Transfigurations, Vol 2''}}
'''The Red Grail''', also called '''The Great Mother''', '''The Mother of Mountains''', and '''The Source''', is one of the [[Hours]], associated with hour XV, or 3:00pm. Her [[Aspects|Aspect]] is {{Lore|Grail}}, and she governs blood, birth and the drowning waters. By most accounts, The Red Grail was the very first God-from-Blood; in some, however, [[The Moth]] was the first. The Red Grail drained [[The Tide]], one of the Gods-from-Stone, and condemned it to [[Nowhere]]. She was responsible for the ascension of the [[The Witch-and-Sister|Twins]]. Later, she "grew jealous of their power", and arranged the ascension and destruction of the [[The Thunderskin|Thunderskin]]. Other accounts say she destroyed the Thunderskin as restitution to [[The Horned-Axe]] for the [[The Lithomachy|destruction of the other Gods-from-Stone]]. She may have played a role in the [[Intercalate|Division of the Sun]], but she did not enact it herself.

She is heavily associated with [[wikipedia:Cybele|Cybele]], a [[Phrygian]] mother goddess associated with castration, whose worship spread throughout the Roman Empire.
